mapper.select: select a.id, a.login_id, a.password, m.id as managerId, coalesce(m.classroom_id, t.classroom_id) as classroomId, t.id as tutorId from accounts as a left join managers as m on a.id = m.account_id left join tutors as t on a.id = t.account_id where a.login_id = #{loginId}

select a.id, a.login_id, a.password, m.id as managerId, coalesce(m.classroom_id, t.classroom_id) as classroomId, t.id as tutorId from accounts as a left join managers as m on a.id = m.account_id left join tutors as t on a.id = t.account_id where a.id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: update accounts set login_id = #{loginId}, password = #{password} where id = #{id}
